meta.parties: Mohamed Bhoy Et Al. v. Maria Dias Et Al

rules.statement: The agreement was not a 'bill of sale' within the meaning of Ordinance No. 8 of 1871, and therefore did not need to be registered within fourteen days.
rules.supporting_quote: "As under section 17 of Frauds, so also under section 2 of the Ordinance we are construing, 'delivery' is an alternative to a written record as the condition precedent to the validity of the transaction, and that is a reason for holding that the kind of property contemplated was such as is capable of delivery. The property here dealt with was incapable of delivery, for, although it has been spoken of as a sum of money, that money was not anywhere to be found in specie."
